events.description: A large group of individuals, many wearing dark clothing and some with helmets or masks, are seen running along a city street, crossing sidewalks and barriers, in a coordinated and urgent manner suggestive of violent unrest or fleeing from/engaging with authorities. The movement escalates from scattered motion to a dense, fast-moving crowd.

A group of individuals, some wearing dark clothing and masks, are seen running along a sidewalk and street, with some appearing to throw objects or engage in coordinated movement suggestive of unrest; the scene includes scattered bystanders, a cyclist, and vehicles, consistent with a violent group clash or dispersal during civil unrest.

At approximately 8.5–10.0 seconds, two individuals near the parked grey car appear to engage in physical contact: one in dark clothing lunges toward another who is recoiling or being pushed back; motion blur suggests active grappling or shoving.

Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat on the sidewalk and street, including punching, grappling, and chasing; a person is knocked to the ground around 12.5s and remains surrounded by others engaged in fighting.

A group of people (at least 8–10) are involved in coordinated violent unrest: running, converging, attacking, and surrounding individuals; police or security personnel in dark gear arrive and intervene from ~10.5s onward, indicating escalation beyond isolated fighting.

Multiple individuals in dark clothing are engaged in a physical altercation on the street; at least one person is on the ground being struck or restrained by others while others surround and participate.
A person is lying on the ground, apparently incapacitated, while multiple others stand over and strike or press down on them—consistent with abuse of a helpless victim.

Multiple individuals in dark clothing and helmets surround and physically subdue a person lying on the ground on a city street; the victim appears restrained and unable to resist while others stand over them.

A group of uniformed or heavily dressed individuals (appearing to be police or security) engage in coordinated physical control of a person on the street amid a tense urban setting with bystanders and vehicles; the collective action exhibits characteristics of violent unrest or suppression rather than isolated incident.
Multiple uniformed officers in riot gear surround and physically subdue a person lying on the ground on a city street; the individual appears restrained and unable to resist.

A group of individuals in tactical/riot gear actively engage with a person on the ground while others converge, indicating collective violent action beyond isolated arrest; background shows additional personnel moving toward the scene.
